recommendation: Keep the published fix. The remaining Observation search-parameter source should stay as-is; any broader reconsideration of Observation value search behavior should use a new OO decision or the already represented related issue audits.
issue_request: FHIR-41002 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 Orders and Observations change request asking to remove Observation.value-canonical, Observation.value-markdown, and Observation.component-value-canonical search parameters because FHIR-40560 removed the corresponding Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x] choices.
initial_application: The direct search-parameter cleanup had already been applied in source history: 02474e83d75 changed Observation-value-markdown to Observation-value-string, and 66ee797aab removed/commented out the remaining value-canonical and component-value-canonical search parameters. Current source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml contains no invalid canonical or markdown Observation value search parameters.
additional_context: FHIR-40560 and the 2023-03-06 OO HCP minutes confirm canonical and markdown were removed from both Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x]. Later FHIR-45455 commit 8926ed3049 added FHIRPath examples and introduced Observation.value.ofType(canonical) on the built source/fhirpath.html page, recreating the same invalid Observation value expression outside the search-parameter bundle. Related Observation value search-parameter audits for FHIR-44931, FHIR-45339, and FHIR-41255 were already represented on the combined branch and were not republished.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhirpath.html to use Observation.value.ofType(string) instead of Observation.value.ofType(canonical). No change was made to the Observation search-parameter bundle because it is already correct for FHIR-41002.
source_changes: source/fhirpath.html: replaced the stale ofType(canonical) Observation.value example with ofType(string).

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification decision that removed canonical and markdown from Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x], making the FHIR-41002 parameters and stale FHIRPath example invalid.
